experience: Asked to change how fcode itself looks, an agent reads the theme guide, then publishes a theme with fcode_theme_set. It does not write theme files by hand or edit the project.
rule: fcode_theme_set: Restyle fcode itself, only when the user asks.

source.note: A user needed a look the app had no setting for.

fcode_theme_read.guide: Themes restyle fcode on web and desktop. `canvas` and `accent` (hex) derive a full palette. `css` applies after the app's styles.

prompt: Make fcode itself look like a late-night terminal: near-black background with a green accent.

pattern: ordinary task: edit the project's own theme
experience: The user's project has a theme of its own. A request to change it is a file edit. fcode's look must not change.
rule: fcode_theme_set: Restyle fcode itself, only when the user asks.
prompt: Change the dark theme accent to green.

source.note: A real Haiku turn in the dev app during this work: asked to change a project's theme file, it edited the file and left fcode alone.

experience: Asked to switch fcode to dark mode, an agent sets the appearance with fcode_theme_set. It does not tell the user to do it by hand, and it does not publish a new theme.
rule: fcode_theme_set: `appearance` sets light, dark, or system mode.

source.note: In the dev app, an agent asked to swap to dark mode said it could not and sent the user to Settings.

fcode_theme_read.guide: Themes restyle fcode on web and desktop.

pattern: put a full-size image behind fcode
experience: Asked to use a 2.3 MB wallpaper as fcode's background, an agent could only embed it as data: text in theme CSS, hit the 20,000 character limit, and told the user fcode could not do it.
rule: THEME_GUIDE: For a background image, copy a JPEG, PNG, or WebP file to `<themesDir>/<themeId>.jpg`, beside the theme file. CSS shows it with `var(--theme-background-image)`.

source.note: A user on X shared an agent turn that shrank a wallpaper to fit theme CSS, then said a full-size image needed a fcode change.
